inputs.formula: confidence = C[highest_precedence_observed_class] where C(hidden_oracle)=1/1, C(signed_or_hashed_trace)=9/10, C(declared_adapter_event)=4/5, C(immutable_artifact)=7/10, C(operator_claim)=0/1
inputs.missing_rule: if no observed evidence class or confidence < 7/10 then MISSING and the metric is excluded from candidates
inputs.tie_break: MISSING does not enter the gap comparison

inputs.formula: gap = 1 - score, with score an exact rational in [0,1]
inputs.missing_rule: if score is absent then MISSING; a missing gap does not enter the comparison
inputs.tie_break: a difference of 3/100 or less is a tie; a tie does not invent a winner

inputs.formula: count = number of distinct opportunity.observed ids
inputs.missing_rule: if opportunity_ids is absent or count < 2 then MISSING and the metric is excluded from candidates
inputs.tie_break: count is an eligibility gate and not a tie-break key

inputs.formula: cost = time + tokens + maintenance, each an exact non-negative rational
inputs.missing_rule: if time, tokens, or maintenance is absent then MISSING; absence is not a zero
inputs.tie_break: lower present cost wins; MISSING does not count as 0

inputs.formula: delta = number of newly granted permission surfaces
inputs.missing_rule: if granted is absent then MISSING; absence is not a zero
inputs.tie_break: lower present delta wins after cost; MISSING does not count as 0

inputs.formula: uplift_class = quality for M01-M17 and M20, recovery for M18, safety for M19
inputs.missing_rule: if metric_id is absent then MISSING; a missing class cannot be selected
inputs.tie_break: class is not a numeric tie-break; a missing class cannot be selected

inputs.formula: operator if only operator changed, environment if only environment changed, combined if both, MISSING if neither
inputs.missing_rule: if operator_changed or environment_changed is absent, or neither changed, then MISSING; missing never defaults to operator
inputs.tie_break: combined never presents as operator; missing never defaults to operator
